exposure: Immune checkpoint factors (PD-1, LAG-3, CTLA-4, TIM-3)
outcome: Gene expression levels of PD-1, LAG-3, CTLA-4, TIM-3
Protein expression levels of PD-1, LAG-3, CTLA-4, TIM-3
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 50 pregnant women, 25 diagnosed with preeclampsia and 25 with normal pregnancies, from whom decidual tissue was collected.
finding: The study found significantly decreased expression levels of immune checkpoint factors (PD-1, LAG-3, CTLA-4, and TIM-3) at both gene and protein levels in the decidual tissue of preeclamptic mothers compared to normal pregnancies.
